title: Deep learning detects intracranial aneurysms on CT angiography in a multicohort study
summary: A deep learning framework trained on 1,177 DSA-verified bone-removal CTA cases achieved higher sensitivity and negative predictive value than radiologists in consecutive internal and external cohorts, and 96.8% of predicted-negative cases in suspected acute ischemic stroke could be trusted. A prospective study is still warranted. This is a medRxiv preprint.
